items.title: South Pole Region of the Moon as Seen by Clementine
items.description: This orthographic projection is centered on the south polar region of the moon as seen by NASA Clementine spacecraft. The Schrodinger Basin is located in the lower right of the mosaic.

items.title: Moon Rugged South Polar Region Composite
items.description: This composite image depicts the moon rugged south polar region in two lights. The color image is the highest resolution topography map to date of the moon south pole.

items.title: VIPER Drill
items.description: An illustration of the VIPER Rover searching for water at the south pole of the Moon.

items.title: North Pole Region of the Moon as Seen by Clementine
items.description: Lunar mosaic of ~1500 NASA Clementine images of the north polar region of the moon.

items.title: Lunar South Pole - Out of the Shadows
items.description: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter captured this image of the ejecta blanket and rim of Timocharis crater in southeastern Mare Imbrium.

items.title: Artist’s Rendering of NASA’s PROMISE Lunar Rover
items.description: Artist’s rendering of NASA’s PROMISE lunar rover on a rugged, gray lunar landscape beneath a star-filled black sky. Viewed from a low angle, the rover features large, treaded wheels, a white and metallic body, and mounted instruments.

items.title: NASA Releases First Interactive Mosaic of Lunar North Pole
items.description: Scientists, using cameras aboard NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter LRO, have created the largest high resolution mosaic of our moon north polar region.

items.title: Graben on the Moon
items.description: These graben - a kind of trench that is formed as a surface expands - were imaged near a region of the Moon called Mare Frigoris by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO).

items.title: Lobate Scarps on the Moon
items.description: This image of lobate scarps - a kind of curved hill - was taken near a region of the Moon called Mare Frigoris by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO).

items.title: Wrinkle Ridges on the Moon
items.description: Scientists have discovered these wrinkle ridges in a region of the Moon called Mare Frigoris. These ridges add to evidence that the Moon has an actively changing surface. This image was taken by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO).

items.title: Lunar Flashlight (Artist's Concept)
items.description: This artist's concept shows the Lunar Flashlight spacecraft, a six-unit CubeSat designed to search for ice on the Moon's surface using special lasers.

items.title: Lunar Flashlight from Above (Artist's Concept)
items.description: This artist's concept shows a view from above the Lunar Flashlight spacecraft, a six-unit CubeSat designed to search for ice on the Moon's surface using special lasers.

items.title: CAPSTONE facing the Sun (Illustration)
items.description: CAPSTONE, a microwave oven-sized CubeSat, will fly in cislunar space – the orbital space near and around the Moon. The mission will demonstrate an innovative spacecraft-to-spacecraft navigation solution at the Moon from a near rectilinear halo orbit slated for Artemis’ Gateway. Illustration by Daniel Rutter.
